recent_posts.title: This Week in Rails: May 1, 2026
recent_posts.summary: Weekly Rails update covering: updated documentation guides (Asset Pipeline, Layouts & Rendering, Caching, Active Job Basics) open for community review; reminder to apply for the Rails at Scale Summit by May 8; new Rails apps now enable frozen string literals by default via config/bootsnap.rb with corresponding RuboCop configuration; a bug fix for find_signed raising ArgumentError on models with composite primary keys; and a fix allowing aliases for unions in the from clause that previously caused PostgreSQL errors.

recent_posts.title: Active Record gets better every week
recent_posts.summary: This week in Ruby on Rails covers several Active Record and Rails improvements: PostgreSQL minimum version bumped to 10.0, add_column now raises an error when null: true is set on primary keys, extending on ActiveRecord::Relation is now up to twice as fast, a bug with nested with_connection and lease_connection sticky flags is fixed, and a TTOU signal hang when ffmpeg is spawned for ActiveStorage video previews is resolved. Also announced: Rails World 2026 speaker applications and the 2026 Ruby on Rails Community Survey.

recent_posts.title: Query command for database queries and more
recent_posts.summary: This week in Rails covers several new features and fixes merged into the Rails codebase. The headline addition is a new `rails query` command that runs read-only database queries and returns structured JSON output, with subcommands like `query schema`, `query models`, and `query explain`. Other changes include appending `charset=utf-8` to Content-Type headers for static CSS and HTML files, adding an offline fallback page to the PWA scaffold, a rewrite of the Layouts and Rendering guide, a fix for IO copy stream writing to Action Controller Live Buffer, a fix for `reset_counters` with string IDs, a performance improvement in `ParameterFilter` using hash lookups for exact-match regexp filters, and stronger documentation warnings about Active Storage redirect and proxy mode security risks.

recent_posts.title: Explicit query: and body: kwargs for integration tests and more!
recent_posts.summary: This week in Rails covers several notable changes: new explicit `query:` and `body:` keyword arguments for integration test helpers to resolve ambiguity with GET+JSON requests in API-only apps; two new predicate methods `request.safe_method?` and `request.unsafe_method?` on ActionDispatch::Request per RFC 9110; a fix to Action Cable's origin check to respect X-Forwarded-Host behind reverse proxies; and an open PR rewriting the Layouts and Rendering guide. Nine contributors participated this week.

recent_posts.title: Speedup ActiveRecord::LogSubscriber#sql
recent_posts.summary: A weekly roundup of Rails codebase changes covering performance improvements, deprecations, and bug fixes. Highlights include anchoring regexp patterns in ActiveRecord::LogSubscriber#sql_color to avoid timeout issues, adding a fast path for string cache keys in ActiveSupport::Cache, a new prepend: true option for ActiveSupport::Notifications.subscribe, deprecation of schema_order and MySQL strict options, predefining well-known Postgres type OIDs to avoid per-connection queries, Unicode fix for Inflector#titleize, composite key fixes in associations, and the addition of an AGENTS.md guide for AI coding agents contributing to Rails.

recent_posts.title: This Week in Rails: March 27, 2026
recent_posts.summary: Rails 7.2.3.1, 8.0.4.1, and 8.1.2.1 were released as security patches, followed by bugfix releases 8.0.5 and 8.1.3. Key changes include: Active Record's `validates` now combines top-level and per-validator `:if`/`:unless`/`:on` options instead of letting inner options silently override outer ones; `titleize` now correctly capitalizes Unicode lowercase letters (e.g., über → Über); and MySQL error 1046 (ER_NO_DB_ERROR) is now classified as `ActiveRecord::ConnectionFailed` to enable automatic retries. 18 contributors participated this week.

recent_posts.title: This Week in Rails: March 20, 2026
recent_posts.summary: Weekly changelog for Ruby on Rails covering changes merged in the week of March 20, 2026. Highlights include batching SQL statements when creating tables for improved schema loading performance, deprecation of require_dependency ahead of Rails 9 removal, new MySQL lock and algorithm options for DDL operations (add_index, remove_index, add_column, change_column, remove_column, rename_column), Dockerfile build performance optimizations for new Rails apps, PostgreSQL RESET command support in read-only query contexts, and Action Text changes allowing block children in editor elements alongside a value attribute.

recent_posts.title: Validate URI scheme in Action Text and more
recent_posts.summary: This week's Rails fixes include: a URI scheme validation added to Action Text's markdown link conversion to prevent disallowed schemes (like data: URIs) from being emitted as links; a fix restoring the previous instrumenter after execute_or_skip to prevent contamination on caller threads; and a fix for SQLite virtual table parsing that previously crashed the schema dumper during db:migrate.

recent_posts.title: This Week in Rails: March 6, 2026
recent_posts.summary: Weekly roundup of Rails codebase changes for the week of March 6, 2026. Highlights include: read-only permissions for GitHub Actions workflows generated by rails new, removal of load hook guards for action_dispatch_request and action_cable, improved Trix/Action Text markdown support with del tag and div handler, PostgreSQL 9.5+ requirement now documented, fixes for Encoding::CompatibilityError with non-ASCII strict locals defaults, IsolatedExecutionState.share_with fix for fiber isolation level, and a fix for collection caching to preserve store default expires_in. 12 contributors participated this week.

recent_posts.title: Action Text gets Markdown conversion, editor links in devcontainers...
recent_posts.summary: A weekly Rails update covering several new changes: Action Text gains a `to_markdown` method that converts rich text HTML to Markdown with support for inline formatting, lists, tables, and links. `MissingAttachable` now renders as '☒' in plain text. HTTP authentication methods get a new `content_type` parameter for customizing 401 responses. A new `RAILS_HOST_APP_PATH` environment variable enables correct 'open in editor' links when working inside devcontainers or Docker setups. 14 contributors participated this week.

top_posts.title: End of April 2023 Edition
top_posts.summary: The venerable @p8 has been very busy trying to improve our SEO posture with search engines. The PostgreSQL guide received new sections on INCLUDE, UNIQUE, and EXCLUde. We had 30 contributors to the Ruby codebase this past week.

top_posts.title: Rails World 2025 dates announced and more!
top_posts.summary: Rails World 2025 is scheduled for September 4-5 in Amsterdam, with more tickets available. Noteworthy changes in Rails include raising a specific error for unknown job classes during deserialization, improved error highlighting for multi-line methods in ERB templates, YJIT disabled by default in development and test environments, and a new WEB_CONCURRENCY=auto setting for Puma. The kamal dbc command will no longer ask for a database password when run.

top_posts.title: Rails console improvements, assertionless tests reporting and more!
top_posts.summary: Rails console is now built on top of IRB's latest official APIs. The app:update task is now a command with a --force flag. The PostgreSQL adapter now has a Date decoder.

top_posts.title: Better error message, opt-in devcontainers and more!
top_posts.summary: This post discusses several changes in the Rails codebase, including improved error messages for misconfigured Store columns, the option to opt-in for automatically_invert_plural_associations, and the introduction of a devcontainer command for Rails 7.2.

top_posts.title: Rails World CFP, ActiveRecord::Base.with_connection, devcontainer a...
top_posts.summary: Rails World CFP is now open for the conference in Toronto, Canada. The .devcontainer folder is now generated by default for new apps. ActiveRecord::Base.with_connection is a shortcut for leasing a connection. Proper support for encrypting binary columns in PostgreSQL is added. Puma-dev is suggested for local development. The list of changes can be viewed.
